what:
When a thin serif title comes within 50px of the screen bottom, characters rise one by one at 0.1s intervals from 20% below over 1s as they appear (a blank also takes one slot in the sequence). Runs once — when splitting, the inner ·
Leave the same decoration as is

options.dur: Duration of one character rising into view (sec), default 1
options.rise: Rise distance — % of the water-surface text height, or add px for that exact distance (large English type 200px), default 20
options.offset: Starts this many px before the screen bottom (+ means before it is visible), default 50 — append % for a share of screen height (brand -25%)
options.ease: Curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a CSS name), default ease-in-out — Brand 0.25,1,0.5,1
options.delay: First character delay (s), default 0 — Brand hero 2.6
options.on: ”load” starts right away without waiting to become visible · ”state” starts when is-in is added to the element or an ancestor (the first Hero title that enters after the loader clears)
options.look: If clip, hides letters that go outside the element (a shape rising from below the line)
options.blur: Blur-to-sharp amount (px), default 0 (no blur) — Brand vertical name 6
options.fade: Opacity/blur curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a CSS name), same as the default ease — Brand A linear (only the position follows the curve) · none leaves opacity as is and only moves position (Brand B, together with look: clip: opaque text rises from under the mask)
options.from: Spread order — start (default, from the first letter) · center (from the middle letters outward) · end (from the last letter)
options.axis: With x, the text slides in from the side instead of from below (rise is the horizontal distance) — for vertical-writing lines. Vertical lead: axis: x; rise: -100; look: clip; fade: none; dur: .8; each: .08; ease: .33,1,.68,1, delay per line .08·.23·.38… (.15 per line)
options.pause: Extra pause (seconds) after a comma-like character, default 0 — nii-photo ”、” followed by .6 (.3s, then the next character appears in 1s)
